items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: A guy named Pat Patrick was playing saxophone.

ctx.x: You said it was Rodgers Grant – was it Rodgers Grant that introduced you to Mongo? So I’m always wondering – because I’ve played Latin music, and there’s a – we talk about music as a language. That’s a different language – I’m just wondering, how did you prepare? What was it that you felt you were going to bring to Mongo? Or how did you get in Mongo’s band? Let’s start with that.
A guy named Pat Patrick was playing saxophone.
